input.error_message: raw_url is missing or invalid under canonical-url-v1

features.name: raw_url_codepoint_length
features.definition: Number of Unicode code points in the untouched raw URL string.

features.name: raw_url_utf8_byte_length
features.definition: Number of bytes in the UTF-8 encoding of the untouched raw URL string.

features.name: hostname_ascii_length
features.definition: Number of ASCII characters in the hostname after the existing IDNA normalization.

features.name: path_codepoint_length
features.definition: Number of Unicode code points in the path returned by urlsplit.

features.name: query_codepoint_length
features.definition: Number of Unicode code points in the query returned by urlsplit, excluding the query delimiter.

features.name: fragment_codepoint_length
features.definition: Number of Unicode code points in the fragment returned by urlsplit, excluding the fragment delimiter.

features.name: hostname_label_count
features.definition: Number of dot-delimited labels in the IDNA-normalized ASCII hostname.

features.name: hostname_ascii_digit_count
features.definition: Number of ASCII digits in the IDNA-normalized ASCII hostname.

features.name: hostname_hyphen_count
features.definition: Number of hyphen characters in the IDNA-normalized ASCII hostname.

features.name: hostname_punycode_label_count
features.definition: Number of IDNA-normalized hostname labels beginning with xn--.

features.name: path_segment_count
features.definition: Number of nonempty slash-delimited segments in the urlsplit path.

features.name: query_parameter_count
features.definition: Zero when the urlsplit query is empty; otherwise the number of ampersand-delimited query fields, including empty fields.

features.name: raw_url_ascii_letter_count
features.definition: Number of ASCII A-Z or a-z code points in the untouched raw URL string.

features.name: raw_url_ascii_digit_count
features.definition: Number of ASCII 0-9 code points in the untouched raw URL string.

features.name: raw_url_other_codepoint_count
features.definition: Number of code points outside ASCII A-Z, a-z, and 0-9 in the untouched raw URL string.

features.name: raw_url_ascii_digit_ratio
features.definition: ASCII digit count divided by raw URL code-point length.

features.name: raw_url_other_codepoint_ratio
features.definition: Other-code-point count divided by raw URL code-point length.

features.name: raw_url_unique_codepoint_count
features.definition: Number of distinct Unicode code points in the untouched raw URL string.

features.name: raw_url_utf8_byte_entropy_bits
features.definition: Shannon entropy in bits using base-2 logarithms over the UTF-8 byte-frequency distribution of the untouched raw URL string.

features.name: percent_escape_count
features.definition: Number of valid percent triplets matching percent followed by two hexadecimal digits in the untouched raw URL string.

features.name: is_https
features.definition: One when the urlsplit scheme equals https after ASCII lowercase conversion; otherwise zero.

features.name: has_userinfo
features.definition: One when the raw urlsplit authority contains an at-sign; otherwise zero.

features.name: has_explicit_port
features.definition: One when the raw authority after any user information contains an explicit decimal port delimiter and value; otherwise zero.

features.name: has_query_delimiter
features.definition: One when the untouched raw URL contains a query delimiter before any fragment delimiter; otherwise zero.

features.name: has_fragment_delimiter
features.definition: One when the untouched raw URL contains a fragment delimiter; otherwise zero.

threshold_selection.candidate_thresholds: unique validation scores plus the finite no-alert threshold nextafter(maximum validation score, +infinity)
threshold_selection.constraint: exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson false-positive-rate upper confidence bound <= 0.01
